title: One Step East? Unit Vectors Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A map says three blocks east. A friend says four steps north. Every instruction has two parts: how much, and which way. So what exactly is one step east? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 3, Motion in a Plane) we meet unit vectors, the building blocks of every vector.

We build 3î + 4ĵ from unit steps on a live simulation, then stretch the arrow from size 5 to 10 while its unit vector stays at size 1 and only turns. We derive Â = A/|A| step by step, see why a unit vector has no unit and no dimension, and write any vector as A = A Â = Ax î + Ay ĵ. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example on Aarav's walk, the exam trap about units, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.
